info.title: Athenaeum Library Management System API
info.description: REST API for a production-style library management system: auth, catalog, circulation, reservations, fines, reports, and notifications.

Conflict.description: Conflicting state (e.g. duplicate, no copies left)

post.summary: Log in and receive an access token (refresh token set as an httpOnly cookie)
Rotate tokens using the refresh cookie
Check out an available copy of a book

userId.description: Staff-only: check out on behalf of another member

post.summary: Renew a loan (max 2 renewals, blocked if a reservation queue exists)

get.summary: List the current user's own loans

post.summary: Add physical copies to a book (admin/librarian)

get.summary: List all physical copies of a book (admin/librarian)

post.summary: Retire a copy as lost (only from 'available'; admin/librarian)
Join the hold queue for a book
Cancel a waiting or ready reservation

get.summary: List the current user's reservations, with live queue position
List the current user's fines and pending balance

post.summary: Waive a pending fine with a reason (admin/librarian)
